excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上持续的发掘工作出土了一小堆古董物件。[Root.GetLeaderName]在这之中鉴定出了一些稀有文物。
excerpt.en: Our continued excavations on [From.Planet.GetName] have unearthed a small cache of antique objects. [Root.GetLeaderName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上持续的发掘工作出土了一小堆古董物件。[Root.GetLeaderName]在这之中鉴定出了一些稀有文物。
texts.en: Our continued excavations on [From.Planet.GetName] have unearthed a small cache of antique objects. [Root.GetLeaderName] has identified several minor artifacts among them.

texts.zh: 一些稀有文物于近期由[Root.GetLeaderName]在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古站点上发现。它们目前正在运往一个安全的科学设施的途中。
texts.en: Some minor artifacts were recently discovered by [Root.GetLeaderName] at the archaeology site on [From.Planet.GetName]. They are currently in the process of being shipped to a secure science facility.

texts.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]上遗迹的发掘中，一部分地面最近发生了坍塌，使得我们的一些[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]跌落到一个小裂口中。幸运的是他们不仅在事故中毫发无伤，还发现了一些稀有文物。
texts.en: A section of floor at the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName] recently gave way, sending several of our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] tumbling down a small chasm. Fortunately they not only emerged unharmed from the incident, but they also found several minor artifacts.
